queries.name: Shortest path to Domain Admins from Owned

queryList.query: MATCH p=shortestPath((n)-[*1..]->(g:Group)) WHERE n.owned=true AND g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN p
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn=true RETURN u.name, u.description ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.dontreqpreauth=true RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name

queries.name: Service accounts that are Domain Admins

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' AND u.name STARTS WITH 'SVC' RETURN u.name

queries.name: Computers where my owned principals have admin

queryList.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AdminTo]->(c:Computer) WHERE n.owned=true RETURN p
